correctness.rationale: For fixed R>0, ρ≥0, squared distances x_i=R²+ρ²−2Rρ cos(θ−2πi/3) have angle-independent S1=3(R²+ρ²), S2=3(R⁴+R²ρ²+ρ⁴), and product R⁶+ρ⁶−2R³ρ³cos3θ. Let p=sum d_i, e=sum d_i d_j, q=prod d_i. Algebra p²=S1+2e and e²=S2+2pq gives dq/dp=(ep−q)/p>0 for nonnegative d_i not all zero; hence extrema of p occur exactly at cos3θ=±1. Direct evaluation gives both radical endpoints and all six equality rays. ρ=0 yields 3R, ρ=R admits zero distance without invalidating strict positivity. Independently sampled 6498 (R,ρ,angle) configurations; finite grid supplementary.
